The '''1956–57 Cypriot First Division''' was the 20th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league. This year no relegation took place after an agreement between the clubs.

==Overview==
It was contested by 9 teams, and [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC]] won the championship. There was no relegation this season, because the league was expanded to 10 teams in the next season.
